# Imaging of Adolescent Emotion Processing

### Dataset Availability Notice: Due to the storage issue, we are currently unable to upload all subject folders. At this time, the dataset contains 101 out of 154 subjects. We are actively working to resolve the storage issue and will continue uploading the remaining subject folders once the problem has been addressed. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

Please reach out to Dr. Haley Skymba (hskymba2@illinois.edu) with questions about this dataset.

This study was funded by a University of Illinois Research Board Award and a National Institute of Child Health and Human Development grant (R21 HD097537).

MRI data from 154 adolescent girls were collected using a Siemens Prisma MRI 3 Tesla scanner (Siemens Healthineers, Erlangen, Germany) and a 64-channel head-and-neck coil. Imaging began with an anatomical scan, followed by a shimming routine to optimize signal-to-noise ratios, two opposite phase-encoded magnitude maps, used to calculate field maps, followed by a series of resting state and task-based scans (i.e., Social Evaluation Task (SET) and Emotion Go/No-Go Task (EGNG)). For details about data acquisition and processing, please refer to our publication (in preparation; will update once we have more information) or registered protocol (will update once we have more information).

The notes below describe known scan, task, and file issues for SET and EGNG data. These notes are intended to document the issues rather than prescribe all analysis decisions. Some subjects have missing files, unusable scan data, or were collected using a wrong headcoil protocol and therefore cannot, or generally not recommended to be used.
